_about: Cue table for the Audio Studio runner (docs/spec/60-audio.md sections 2-5). Read by gen-music.mjs and master-audio.mjs. Prompts, seeds and loudness targets live here and nowhere else. beatsPerBar x bars x 60 / bpm is the loop length; duration/seconds is how long the studio is asked to generate (2-4 s longer so the master can be trimmed to whole bars). Prompts describe instruments and mechanism only: no game, studio or composer names, nothing from KB rules.md rule 23.
musicExclusions: instrumental, no vocals, no lyrics, no choir, no electronic synth, no modern drum kit, no pop beat
sfxNegative: music, melody, voices, speech, singing, crowd chatter

cues.prompt: slow solemn ancient Chinese court instrumental for a title screen, guqin low plucked notes and harmonics carrying a broad pentatonic theme, bianzhong bronze bells struck on the downbeat, a soft xiao flute answering, a low drum heartbeat, wide hall reverb, noble and a little sad, D minor pentatonic

gentle spacious instrumental for travelling a peaceful countryside, dizi flute and plucked pipa playing a simple pentatonic phrase, soft zheng arpeggios, light hand percussion, warm and open, slow harmonic movement, G major pentatonic

quiet cold-season instrumental, sparse guqin notes with long silences between them, a high xiao flute held like wind, a distant soft bianzhong bell, low strings sustaining a bare fifth, empty and still, A minor pentatonic

tense instrumental for armies gathering near, low frame drums marching a steady pulse, pipa tremolo and a sharp plucked ostinato, low strings droning, a bronze gong swell every four bars, restrained urgency, E minor pentatonic
dignified instrumental for a council in a lacquered hall, guqin and zheng in slow measured phrases, bianzhong bells marking the ends of phrases, a soft xiao, formal and calm, F major pentatonic

driving war music for a tactical field battle, deep war drums playing a steady rolling pattern, plucked pipa and zheng ostinato, low strings holding a drone, short dizi calls every four bars, bronze gongs on the ends of phrases, determined and rhythmic with open space for a layer on top, steady energy not a climax, D minor pentatonic

layer only, a cavalry charge surge: war drums carrying all the low end with steady eighth notes and accents on one and three, a drum roll swelling in the first bar, fast plucked pipa tremolo and spiccato strings in the mid-high register, rising dizi and suona calls, bronze gongs, relentless and heroic, rising lines with no hummable melody, no bass, no cello, no sub-bass, D minor

tight tense instrumental for a duel between two warriors, a single war drum with sparse heavy hits, sharp plucked pipa accents, a bronze gong shimmer, silences between the phrases, focused and dangerous, A minor pentatonic
thoughtful instrumental for a debate of words at court, guqin and xiao in a measured question-and-answer phrase, a light wooden clapper pulse, plucked zheng, restrained and sly, C major pentatonic
short triumphant victory fanfare, dizi and suona over rolling war drums and bronze bells, a rising pentatonic line resolving to a held D major chord with a natural ring-out, proud and warm
short sorrowful lament, a slow solo xiao phrase over a low drum heartbeat and a single bronze bell, a falling pentatonic line settling on a held note that fades into silence
very short sting for a letter arriving, one plucked guqin phrase of three notes and a soft bronze bell, dry and resolved, over in about five seconds
short sting marking the turn of a month, a bronze bell rung twice with a low drum beat under it and a brief pipa flourish, solemn, resolving in about five seconds
a single soft tap of a fingertip on lacquered wood, dry and close, one tap, no music, no voices
